direct_recollection_2026_09_12.relative_sequence: After the Designia/Louise/Aabenraa internship corridor and after moving into his own place, the Son attended Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.licence_relation: The user tentatively associates the driver's licence with the Produktionsskolen period or close to it, but remains uncertain.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.multimedia_component: Multimedia lessons were part of Produktionsskolen.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.assistant_teacher_role: While enrolled as a student in the multimedia class, the Son often functioned as an informal assistant teacher during lessons. He voluntarily taught substantial parts of the class because his technical ability was ahead of the class material. He did not mind taking on that role.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.role_boundary: This was not a formal teaching appointment or credential; he was a student functioning informally as an assistant teacher inside the class.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.skills_context: Prior IT work, Designia/mediegrafiker training, strong design/software performance and practical computer experience meant parts of the multimedia curriculum were below his existing technical level.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.tree_sequence_relation: The 2011 Tree/psychiatric sequence happened after the Son had stopped attending Produktionsskolen.

public_historical_evidence.evidence: Historical listings identify the formal institution at Skolevej 34, 6640 Lunderskov.

Historical descriptions of the Lunderskov production school describe practical/theoretical workshop activity for under-25s outside completed youth education, matching the autobiographical institutional context.
A specialist silver-makers registry associates a P.SP maker mark with Produktionsskolen and the years 2005–2008.
public_historical_evidence.caution: The 2005–2008 range belongs to the maker-mark evidence and is NOT proof that the school ceased operating or left Lunderskov in 2008. Earlier chronology work over-interpreted this clue.
